info.title: SENA AI Chatbot
info.description:
**Production entry point for all SENA AI conversations.** Frontend hits this endpoint only — the ai-chatbot service routes to staff or policy backends and streams the answer.

**Key Features:**
- Single `/api/route` endpoint for all questions
- Chip-driven routing (no free-text classification)
- Staff and Client sections are completely independent
- Real-time SSE streaming with token usage tracking
- JWT authentication (ISENA tokens from login endpoint)

**Sections:**
- `shifts` → Check Shifts (staff service)
- `client` → Client's Information (staff service)
- `policy` → Policy Questions (policy service)
- `procedure` → Compliance Procedures (policy service)

post.summary: Ask a question in a chip-selected section
post.description:
The **only endpoint you need.** Send a message with a category (chip), and ai-chatbot routes it to the right service and streams the answer.

No free-text classification — the frontend picks the chip (shifts/client/policy/procedure), and that decides the routing. If no category is provided, the request is out of scope.

**Authentication:** Include the JWT token from `/auth/ai/login` in the Authorization header.

**Response:** Server-Sent Events stream with events: `meta` → `token` → `usage` → `done`

value.question: What are my shifts this week?

200.description: SSE stream. Headers: Content-Type: text/event-stream. Each event is `data: <json>`. Stream ends with `data: {"type": "done"}`

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid category

get.description: Returns 200 when ai-chatbot and child services (staff + policy) are healthy.

question.description: The user's message. Can be empty when a chip is tapped without typing.
question.example: What are my shifts this week?

category.description: The tapped chip. Decides the backend service and scope.

session_id.description: Conversation ID to continue a thread. Omit to start fresh.

is_new_chat.description: True to clear prior conversation and start fresh.

context.description: UI context. Must include `category` (the tapped chip).

RouteRequest.description: A user message plus the chip that decides how it's routed.
